$comment: Pinned versions of upstream packages whose docs we mirror. Update both this file and pnpm-workspace.yaml's catalog together, then run `pnpm docs:sync`.

es-toolkit.$comment2: Symbols upstream exports but has never written a reference page for. Each gets a hand-written page under docs/reference/ that docs-sync verifies exists but never overwrites. Delete an entry once upstream backfills its page, then run `pnpm docs:sync` to replace ours with the mirrored copy.

undocumentedUpstream.array/chunkBy: Exported from es-toolkit/array and the root index with full JSDoc (fp/array/chunkBy is a curried wrapper that delegates to it), but has no docs/reference/array/chunkBy.md in any language and no CHANGELOG entry as of v1.50.0.

ts-pattern.$comment: ts-pattern has no per-symbol .md upstream — pages under docs/reference/match/ are hand-written.
